name: aml
description: A light version of automix — an English plan→build→check→record flow for beginners (Codex edition)

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, check, and record a one-line idea.
interface.longDescription: Creates intent.md·spec.md·task.md through an interview ($aml:new), then builds and checks tasks in order and records them in progress.md ($aml:go). Includes review ($aml:review), next round ($aml:next), rule cards ($aml:rule), progress summary ($aml:status), and readiness check ($aml:doctor). All conversation and output is in English.
defaultPrompt: Carry on with the remaining tasks using $aml:go.
